about_the_game:
Pegasis Odyssey is a pixel art shoot’em up combining fast-paced action with strategic progression. As the pilot of a spaceship with upgradable weapons, you are tasked with exploring hostile biomes and facing increasingly formidable enemies. Each attempt offers the chance to experiment with new strategies and invest in permanent upgrades, ensuring continuous and lasting progression.

Explore the different biomes

🌌 In the heart of an infinite universe, a spark of life fights against the darkness. You are the pilot of the Pegasis, a ship forged to navigate cosmic storms and confront the forces lurking in the stellar depths. Each biome is a hostile territory, inhabited by enemies and formidable bosses that will put your reflexes to the test.

Possible upgrades

🚀 But the universe of Pegasis Odyssey does not forgive. When the difficulty becomes insurmountable, you must reset. Each “reset” is not a failure, but an opportunity: you start again stronger, with improved weapons, new abilities, and a refined strategy. Game after game, you progress, you experiment, and you push the boundaries of space further and further.

Your ship is not just a weapon: it is the reflection of your choices, your victories, and your failures turned into strength. The universe stretches out before you, hostile and mysterious. The Pegasis odyssey is endless — how far will you go?

Key Features

A polished and immersive retro pixel art style.

🌍 Varied and ruthless biomes

⚔️ Intense exploration and relentless combat

A balance between reflexes and long-term strategy.

💎 Resources to collect

🔫 Weapons that evolve with you

🚀 A ship that grows stronger game after game

Addictive progression, where each run prepares the next.

🌱 A rich evolution tree

♻️ Strategic resets to go ever further

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Any distribution released after 2016
  • Processor: x86_32 CPU with SSE2 instructions, x86_64 CPU, ARMv7 or ARMv8 CPU
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics with full Vulkan 1.0 support
  • Storage: 400 MB available space

name: Pegasis Odyssey

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: 10
  • Processor: x86_32 CPU with SSE2 instructions, any x86_64 CPU, ARMv8 CPU
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics with full Vulkan 1.0 support or Direct3D 12 (12_0 feature level) support
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 400 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
